  - grilled chicken
  - cut lettuce

  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)

    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
  )

  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at end (grilled ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i))))

    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)

    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)))
